game_flow.description: The game is played over alternating Day and Night Rounds.

phases.name: Round Start
steps: Ensure at least half of Source dice show basic colors

phases.name: Tactics Selection
steps: Each player selects one Tactics card

phases.name: Player Turns
steps: Players take turns in Tactics order
Continue until End of Round is announced

phases.name: End of Round
conditions: A player with empty Deed deck may announce End of Round instead of taking a turn
If hand and Deed deck are empty, End of Round must be announced
Each other player gets one final turn

regular_turn.description: A normal turn with optional movement followed by one action.

phases.name: Movement Phase
rules: Generate Move points
Move through adjacent accessible spaces
Explore new tiles from edge spaces
Movement may provoke rampaging enemies

phases.name: Action Phase
notes: Only one action type may be performed per turn

rest_turn.description: A turn focused on recovery instead of action.

options.name: Standard Rest
options.description: Discard one non-Wound card and all Wound cards from hand.

options.name: Slow Recovery
options.condition: Only if you have only Wound cards in hand
options.description: Discard one Wound card from hand.

steps: Return and reroll any Source die used
Perform Forced Withdrawal if not on a safe space

combat.description: Combat follows a strict phase order.

phases.name: Ranged and Siege Attack Phase
rules: Use Ranged and Siege Attacks before enemies strike
Fortified enemies require Siege in this phase
Attack total must equal or exceed enemy Armor

phases.name: Block Phase
rules: Each surviving enemy attacks separately
Block must equal or exceed enemy Attack
Swift doubles the Block requirement
Inefficient elemental Blocks are halved and rounded down
Insufficient Block does not reduce damage

phases.name: Assign Damage Phase
rules: Assign damage from unblocked enemies
Units may absorb damage unless Assassination applies
Hero Armor determines how many Wounds are taken
Poison, Paralyze, Brutal and Vampiric apply here

phases.name: Attack Phase
rules: Use any Attack type against surviving enemies
Enemy resistances make matching attacks inefficient
Gain Fame for defeated enemies
Fleeing lets all unblocked enemies hit
No rewards are gained
Must be on an edge hex
Costs 2 Move points
Draw and place the top tile from the correct tile deck
Moving between two spaces adjacent to a rampaging enemy provokes it
Safe Movement avoids provoking
Contains player count plus 2 dice
Each player may use one Source die per turn
Used die gives pure mana of its shown color
Used die is rerolled at end of turn
Black is depleted during Day and Gold is depleted during Night
Only basic colors can be stored as crystals
Crystals persist
A crystal can be converted to pure mana during the turn

special.Gold: Day only, substitutes for any basic color.
special.Black: Night only, used for black/night effects.
